title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content: 看着小夜远去，青焰散人眯着眼，陷入沉思。青焰散人名叫路天辰，金丹修士，其师傅贺一萍，元婴修士，很是厉害，但为人低调，不显名声，所处是一个叫莲花宗的门派，门下弟子不多，小夜母亲路天梅也是贺一萍弟子，是青焰散人的姐姐。兄妹二人下面还有三个师弟师妹，三师妹刘霞，人称落叶仙子，四师弟山君方，道号封尘居士，人称万里倾沙，五师弟贺楠，人称一剑问魂，道号追风真人，五人中贺楠是师傅的亲侄子，年龄小，剑法最高，境界也最高，已是金丹后期，喜欢独来独往，少言语，是个苦修士，经常悄无声息出门数十载，又悄无声息回山闭关。五人有个师伯安泰，元婴境，垂垂老矣，没几年活头了，有一师叔，金丹后期，很年轻，比青焰散人还年轻。门内第三代、第四代弟子也不多。莲花宗山门在南域大州，离这儿相隔甚远，坐传送阵要转十余次，费用不菲，中途还要飞行数月。佳小夜所处的地方在大陆的西方，整个西土境内，就数佳家势力大，族里元婴境修士近二十余位，金丹期修士九百余名，筑基、练气修士不知其数，据悉，族内还有个化神老祖，不过千百年都不露面了，是死是活，天下人都不得而知。佳家势力很大！各大州都有分店、堂口、商楼。修真百艺，无所不有，除去自家人外，还有众多供奉、客卿，雇工、奴隶。佳家光是上品灵山、灵脉、灵矿就有近百条，中品、下品的不计其数。灵园、灵茶、灵果、灵药应有尽有，另外，佳家和杜家、玄阳宗、冥鸿门这三个巨无霸共同掌管一处秘境叫做裂缘秘境，以便供自家弟子、门人、后辈前往历练。当然，散修和其他门派也可以定期派人参加，但是，需要给这四大巨头缴纳一定的灵石或者资源。据外界猜测，佳家独自掌握着两处秘境，不对外开放。佳家最出名的不仅仅是势力强大，而是一大绝技--幻缘灵犀指，此技可破万法，定神魂，杀同境如草芥，佳家不仅仅势力大，而且据说和上界也就是灵界有来往，在灵界佳家也有一个庞大的族群，在裂尘界面的佳家只是旁系，嫡系都住在灵界，而且，佳家不只是在一个有界面道统，好几个界面都有佳家人，比如苍木界，血海界，小蒙界，万石界…等等。“是因为佳家强大而神秘，所以师傅才派我和师姐接近他们吗？可是师傅和和佳家的元婴修士排名第七的佳老怪不是交情不错吗，二人不是经常坐而论道吗，佳家七长老曾经在自己的莲花宗小住了三年之久，还指点过自己和几个师姐师弟，有啥事不能当面问七长老”青焰散人默默的思索着，自己和姐姐都是孤儿，自小就被师傅带回山门，并给自己和姐姐取名，教修行，“奇怪的是为啥我们姐弟不跟老师的姓，而是姓路呢？呵呵，当然不是因为我们是弃儿，师傅才带我们回山，而是因为我们有灵根才可以被带上山门，唉！不想了，师傅戴我们恩重如山，亲如父子，我们都几百岁了，就应该替他老人家分忧解愁，我们姐弟俩现在的一切不都是师傅给的吗？没有他老人家，自己现在不过是一堆黄土吧？”手里拿着今天收到师傅的传讯符，路真人静静思考，师傅给的意思简单，让他安排小夜修行，不教本宗的核心法门，买一本大陆货、普通的、陆人皆知的心法就好，顺其自然，不要干涉孩子，等过几年他再安排下一步。路真人绝对是服从师傅的，他不知道师傅想要在佳家得到什么，可他老人家肯定有企图，否则不会把姐姐随便嫁给一个凡人，姐姐刚刚开始哭过，闹过，吵过，结果还不是……姐夫他也见过几次，没好印象，就是个纨绔子弟，吃喝嫖赌，一学就会，而且样样精通，刚生下小夜七天，马上就纳了个小妾，气的姐姐回山门了，再也没来过。姐夫也不在乎，顾了个奶妈，就不过问了，成天的花天酒地。小夜那个爷爷更是不务正业，儿孙太多，也不稀罕小夜，太多孙子了，有时都能叫错名字。像佳家这种绝顶世家，就是凡夫俗子，也是每天啥也不用干，就是纳妾，纳妾，再纳妾！生娃，生娃，再生娃！百个孩子里有一个有灵根的就啥都赚回来了，儿孙里出个有灵根的，上族就会赐下无数的金银财宝、房产田地，足够他们挥霍3代人了。世俗里的佳家人称修仙里佳家人为上族，如果他们3代人里没有带灵根的，就要自食其力了，上族不管死活了，出一个灵根者，管你3代生活无忧。小夜家其实上3代也没有修真者的祖辈，但是，一来前几辈人会经营，二来小夜这一支也算七长老的旁系中的旁系，所以，日子也没有没落下去。佳家在世俗里的不是所有人都衣食无忧，数几代人不出一个灵根者，又不懂一些营生，很快就没落了，福不过三代嘛！甚至沦为乞丐，这些，佳家上族根本不管，冷眼旁观，顺其自然。青焰散人今夜出奇的去没修炼，一直坐着，手里把玩着一个玉佩。“外甥有灵根，他们家长辈还不知道，所以没接，也说的过去，嘿嘿，佳家七长老压根儿不知道有这么个和莲花宗的亲事。再等等吧，实在不行，修炼《太上冲灵决》也不错，没有属性要求。金、木、水、火、土、风、雷、冰灵根都可修炼，中正平和，没有瓶颈，还不影响将来换改功法，一直修下去，一样可问长生大道，嗯，缺点嘛，也就是不适合斗法，没关系，平平安安就好，我们那个长辈不都是希望自己后辈平安健康吗？嘿嘿，唉！看我想啥呢。”路真人海阔天空的胡思乱想着，不由得给姐姐发了个远程传讯符，问问近况，也没指望有回音，默默的打坐去了。
content_en: Watching Xiao Ye go away, Qingyan Sanren squinted his eyes and fell into deep thought.Qingyan Sanren's name is Lu Tianchen, a Golden Core cultivator. His master, He Yiping, is a Nascent Soul cultivator. He is very powerful, but he is low-key and has no reputation. He belongs to a sect called Lotus Sect and has not many disciples. Xiaoye's mother, Lu Tianmei, is also a disciple of He Yiping and is Qingyan Sanren's sister.There are three younger brothers and sisters below them. The third younger brother Liu Xia is known as the Fallen Leaf Fairy. The fourth younger brother Shan Junfang is known as Fengchen Jushi and is known as Wanli Qingsha. The fifth younger brother He Nan is known as Yijianwenhun. The fifth younger brother is known as Zhuifeng Zhenren.Zhong Henan is the nephew of the master. He is young, has the best swordsmanship and the highest realm. He is already in the late stage of Jindan. He likes to be alone and rarely talks. He is an ascetic monk. He often goes out quietly for decades, and then quietly returns to the mountain for retreat.The five of them have an uncle, An Tai, who is in the Nascent Soul realm. He is very old and has not been alive for a few years. There is another uncle, who is in the late stage of Jindan. He is very young, younger than Qingyan Sanren.There are not many third and fourth generation disciples in the sect.The gate of Lotus Sect is in the southern state, which is far away from here. It takes more than ten times to take the teleportation array, which is expensive and requires several months of flying.The place where Jia Xiaoye is located is in the west of the mainland. In the entire Western Territory, the Jia family is the most powerful. There are nearly twenty Yuanying realm monks in the clan, more than 900 Golden Core monks, and countless foundation building and Qi training monks. It is reported that there is an ancestor of the Personalized God in the clan, but he has not shown his face for thousands of years. No one in the world knows whether he is dead or alive.Jiajia is very powerful!There are branches, halls, and commercial buildings in all major states.There are all kinds of cultivation skills. In addition to his own family, there are also many worshippers, guests, hired workers, and slaves.Jiajia has nearly a hundred high-grade spiritual mountains, spiritual veins, and spiritual mines alone, and countless middle-grade and low-grade ones.There are spiritual gardens, spiritual teas, spiritual fruits, and elixirs all available. In addition, the Jiajia, the three giants of the Du family, the Xuanyang Sect, and the Minghongmen jointly manage a secret realm called the Split Fate Secret Realm for their disciples, disciples, and descendants to go and experience.Of course, casual cultivators and other sects can also regularly send people to participate, but they need to pay certain spiritual stones or resources to these four giants.According to outside speculation, Jiajia controls two secret realms alone and is not open to the public.What Jiajia is most famous for is not only its powerful power, but also its unique skill - the phantom spirit finger. This skill can break through all kinds of magic, calm the soul, and kill people in the same realm as grass. Jiajia is not only powerful, but it is also said to have contacts with the upper world, that is, the spiritual world. In the spiritual world, Jiajia is also famous.There is a huge ethnic group. The Jiajia in the Rifting Dust Interface are just collateral lines, and the direct lineage all live in the spirit world. Moreover, the Jiajia is not only in an interface system, there are Jiajia in several interfaces, such as the Cangmu Realm, the Blood Sea Realm, the Xiaomeng Realm, the Ten Thousand Stone Realm... and so on."Is it because the Jiajia family is powerful and mysterious, so the master sent me and my senior sister to get close to them? But isn't the master on good terms with the Jiajia family's seventh-ranked Nascent Soul cultivator, Old Monster Jia? Don't the two of them often sit and discuss the Tao? The seventh elder of the Jiajia family once lived in his Lotus Sect for three years, and he also gave guidance to himself and several masters."Sister and junior brother, if you have anything to do, you can't ask the Seventh Elder face to face." Qingyan Sanren thought silently. He and his sister were both orphans. They were brought back to the mountain by their master when they were young. They named themselves and their sisters and taught them how to practice."What's strange is why our siblings don't take the teacher's surname, but Lu. Haha, of course it's not because we are outcasts, Master?"Fu took us back to the mountain only because we have spiritual roots. Alas! I don’t want to think about it anymore.The master is as kind as a mountain and as close as a father and son. We are hundreds of years old, so we should share his worries. Isn’t everything we have now been given by the master?Without him, we would be just one person.Pile the loess?" Holding the communication talisman that he received from the master today, Lu Zhenren thought quietly. The master's message was simple. He asked him to arrange for a small night practice. He did not teach the core methods of the sect, but just bought a mainland product, a common mental method that is known to everyone in the mainland, let nature take its course, and do not interfere with the child. He would wait for a few years to arrange the next step.Master Lu absolutely obeys his master. He doesn't know what his master wants from Jia's family, but he must have a plan, otherwise he would not marry his sister to a mortal casually. My sister just started crying, making trouble, and arguing, but the result is still notYes... He had met his brother-in-law a few times, but he didn't have a good impression. He was just a playboy, who could eat, drink, whore, and gamble. He could learn everything immediately and was proficient in everything. Seven days after giving birth to Xiao Ye, he immediately took a concubine. The angry sister went back to the mountain gate and never came again.My brother-in-law didn't care. He just took care of a nanny, so he didn't care about it and just spent the whole day living and drinking.Xiaoye's grandfather is not doing his job properly. He has too many children and grandchildren, and he doesn't care about Xiaoye. He has too many grandchildren, and sometimes they call him by the wrong name.Even ordinary people from an elite family like Jiajia don't have to do anything every day, just take concubines, take concubines, take concubines again!Have a baby, have a baby, have another baby!If one of a hundred children has spiritual roots, he can earn everything. If one of his children or grandchildren has spiritual roots, his superiors will give them countless gold, silver, property, and fields, which is enough for them to squander for three generations.The Jia family in the secular world call the Jia family in Xiu Xianli the superior clan. If there is no one with spiritual roots in their three generations, they will have to fend for themselves. The superior clan does not care about life or death. If you have a spiritual root person, your life will be worry-free for the next three generations.In fact, there were no cultivator ancestors in Xiaoye's family for the past three generations. However, firstly, the previous generations knew how to run the business, and secondly, Xiaoye's branch was also considered a branch of the seven elders, so the days did not decline.In the secular world, not everyone in the Jiajia family has no worries about food and clothing. After several generations, there is no one with spiritual roots, and they don’t know how to make a living. They will soon decline. The blessing will not last more than three generations!Even becoming a beggar, the superiors of the Jiajia family didn't care at all, they just watched with cold eyes and let nature take its course.Qingyan Sanren surprisingly didn't practice tonight. He just sat there, playing with a jade pendant in his hand."My nephew has spiritual roots, but their elders don't know about it yet, so they didn't accept it. It makes sense. Hehe, the seventh elder of the Jiajia family didn't know that there was such a marriage with the Lotus Sect. Wait a minute, it really doesn't work. It's not bad to practice "Tai Shang Chong Ling Jue". There are no attribute requirements. Metal, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, thunder, and ice spiritual roots can all be cultivated. It is Zhongzheng and peaceful, there are no bottlenecks, and it will not affect future changes in skills.If you continue to cultivate, you can still ask for the path to immortality. Well, the disadvantage is that it is not suitable for fighting. It doesn't matter.Don't we elders want our descendants to be safe and healthy?Hehe, oh!It depends on what I am thinking." Lu Zhenren couldn't help but send a remote communication charm to his sister to ask about the current situation, but he didn't expect any reply, so he meditated silently.
